description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllNjKagemaneJt]{Kagemane no Jutsu}.

Your shadow is locked to the caster's. You must mirror their physical movements; you cannot Strike, cast jutsu, or take actions that don't have a physical-mimicry equivalent in the caster's available actions. When the caster Strides, you Stride the same direction (within your own Speed).

This effect ends if the caster stops sustaining the jutsu, falls unconscious, moves beyond range, or you escape into total darkness.
